surface_name: Stripe CLI and Dashboard, event resend
title: Resend on an event in the Stripe Dashboard never reaches your stripe listen session
symptoms: Dashboard Resend reports a delivery but nothing arrives at localhost
Webhook attempts list shows only remote endpoints, no CLI response
cause: The Dashboard resends to registered webhook endpoints, and a running stripe listen session is not one of them.
fix: Resend from the CLI, which targets the local listener by default, or pass --webhook-endpoint for a specific endpoint.
affected: Stripe CLI and Dashboard; reported June 2024, still open October 2026
